content.comment_body: Hello, What are the available options for accessing [product_name] webpages outside the local network, for example on a mobile phone? I considered hosting the site on AWS (I have a [version_no] module), but I am having difficulty with configuring the AWS environment. I am now exploring external IPs with DNS, but this brings up issues about modifying various networks in different locations for different clients. I also thought about using the [product_name] communication module, although I haven't tried it yet. Are there other approaches I should consider? What do you think is the best solution for my case? Thanks in advance.
Would setting up a VPN router be the most straightforward and budget-friendly solution? Can consumer-grade VPN routers be used reliably with a [product_name] module? Thanks!

Yes, VPN routers are definitely a good choice. I have experience with Teltonika Routers, such as 240 or 951, using Open VPN Connect—setup is simple and there's no cost. You can use a SIM card or connect an Ethernet cable from your ISP's router to the WAN port of the Teltonika device.

Thank you for your response. It sounds like an effective solution. I'm still interested in a cloud option for use with a [version_no] module as it could provide web server plus cloud capabilities, which might be smarter for my clients. Ideally, I hope to someday have a custom app that collects data from the cloud. My only concern is the potential expense of AWS.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are exploring secure and convenient methods for remotely accessing [product_name] webpages from their modules using smartphones. The discussion covers cloud hosting, VPN router setups, and the trade-offs of each, particularly regarding configuration complexity and cost. There is notable interest in integrating cloud services and developing app-based solutions for easier data management and scalability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking a simple, budget-friendly, and secure way to access [product_name] webpages remotely on mobile devices, with hopes for seamless cloud integration and easy management of multiple clients.
